verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents a public GraphQL API, but the reference explicitly states no schema artifact, SDL download, or introspection guidance is published. Probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The OAuth authorization-server metadata endpoint describes authentication, not the API surface, so it does not count as an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
